notes:
Summary: Axonfold builds a VS Code-first IDE copilot focused on low-latency inline suggestions and streaming completions. Target customers are mid-market developer teams embedding assistants directly in the editor. They want a solution that can scale per-developer and optionally be deployed with VPC for enterprise accounts.

Key quotes: "If latency spikes over 50ms for inline suggestions we see conversion drop in internal trials." — CTO (Maya Lin).

POC ask (high level): 2-week POC integrating Redwood hosted endpoints into their extension dev-channel, sample manifest for per-user auth, token-slicing to control cost, and ability to pin to a specific model family + Fallback policy to cheaper quantized variant under heavy load. Need streaming RTTs and an SDK hook for incremental deltas.

Auth & billing: prefer GitHub OAuth + SSO for enterprise installs. They want per-developer rate-limits with org-wide burst bucket; concerned about token attribution for cost analytics. Asking about webhook/event for token usage and per-route cost breakdown.

Security: full SOC2 + audit logs required for enterprise pilots. KMS support needed (bring-your-own). Data residency: prefer NA region hosting for pilot customers. Must answer code-exfil controls and retention controls for IDE logs.

Integration notes: extension uses event-based streaming (TextDocument/CompletionItem streaming). They requested a sample streaming client for VS Code extension host and guidance on concurrent KV cache usage for multi-file editing.

Business/Commercial: exploring Dedicated for predictable outflow for enterprise customers, hosted for public/self-serve. Budget conversation in progress — expect mid-market commit if POC OK.

Short friction items (from calls): auth token refresh flow ambiguous, expected per-user quotas vs global quotas unclear, want SLA for tail-latency, clarify model pinning semantics & rollback plan.

Next immediate actions: deliver a POC plan + perf baseline template by 2026-03-15, provide draft SOW and data flow diagram, schedule security deep-dive with infra team.
